items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny Warrington, a lot of it. We’d play it with trumpet, trombone and a sax.

ctx.x: With the Nighthawks, how did you get the repertoire? Was this all...

I would go over to Louisville on Saturday, and take my money that I earned from working in the florist, and buy these big band arrangements for dollar-and-a-quarter. I had stacks of them. Johnny Warrington, a lot of it. We’d play it with trumpet, trombone and a sax.
Any of the Van Alexander stock arrangements maybe?
